svg.title: Every answer remembers. Nouli is a decision graph. The README's recall example as a line map: three source sessions blend in two layers into recall-response-updated, which is built on six earlier decisions.
svg.text: Nouli is a decision graph. It runs decision models over many turns and feeds earlier decisions
into later ones. A ledger keeps every fact, question and answer, and each turn sees all of it.
THE RECALL GRAPH · nouli view recall-response-updated · recorded
